text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

angle_info.justification: Relatable story of individual spiritual growth and transformation

narrative_angles.script:

**Script:**

"From emptiness to eternity, my story begins."

In Genesis 1:1, God's power sparks creation from nothingness. This divine energy still stirs within me, calling me to surrender and trust.

My faith journey starts with surrendering control, embracing His power in every moment.

Call out your doubts and fears to God today, and watch Him breathe life into the emptiness of your heart.
